g.text: Love of one’s fate — every setback
is part of the road, not the end of it.
and aiming for Big Tech, one commit at a time.
I’m Adil Akhtab Abir — an IT student from Dhaka, Bangladesh, building
toward production-grade software: websites, applications, automation
I care about the unglamorous parts that make software trustworthy —
and I measure progress in shipped work, not in promises.
